page: Google Cloud Platform ct5l-hightpu-4t is a specialized accelerator-optimized server instance within the ct5l family. It features 112 dedicated vCPUs based on the x86_64 architecture and is equipped with 192.0 GB of system memory. This configuration yields a memory-to-core ratio of 1.71 GB per vCPU, prioritizing compute density and accelerator throughput over general-purpose memory capacity.

The primary hardware acceleration is delivered by four integrated Google TPU v5e chips, providing a combined total of 64 GB of high-bandwidth accelerator memory. This server does not include local storage or complimentary public IPv4 addresses, meaning storage requirements must be met through external network-attached storage options.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ct5l-hightpu-4t offers a dense allocation of specialized tensor processing units relative to its host system resources, making it a highly targeted platform for machine learning workloads. It is designed specifically for deep learning tasks, including neural network training, transformer model inference, and parallelized data science pipelines.
